notes.title: Update 1.0.2 (Menu, Editor, The Taunt)
notes.notes:
Game

    Fixed options menu closing when changing options.
    The Taunt: now requires 3 acid instead of 1 to open the door to the generator room.
 
Editor

    Fixed nonfunctional Buttons

notes.title: Entropy Rising Release Tomorrow!
notes.notes:
Great News! We are happy to announce that Entropy Rising will be released on Steam tomorrow at 10AM Pacific Time (6PM UTC)! 
Many thanks to all our Greenlight supporters for making this possible!
